tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Base token/contract quick check (0.005 USDC via x402, with an optional free trial of 1024 unpaid calls per IP per UTC day; HTTP and MCP share a bucket): on-chain facts only — is contract, ERC-20 metadata, total supply, owner, paused, EIP-1967 proxy/admin, owner and burn-address balances, descriptive

tools.name: web_to_markdown
tools.description: Public webpage to clean Markdown (0.002 USDC via x402, with an optional free trial of 1024 unpaid calls per IP per UTC day; HTTP and MCP share a bucket). Respects robots.txt, refuses login/paywalled pages, 2 MB / 10 s limits, output up to 60k chars.

tools.name: x402_precheck
tools.description: Pre-payment check of an x402 endpoint (0.002 USDC via x402, with an optional free trial of 1024 unpaid calls per IP per UTC day; HTTP and MCP share a bucket): reachable?, latency, live payment terms, canonical-USDC check, and whether terms match its PayAI Bazaar listing. Never pays the target.
